newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs target 130.75/80 on road to 131.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs target 130.75/80 on road to 131.00.

text.p: Italian BTP futures traded on LIFFE must overcome resistance at 130.75/80, highs from the end of February, in order to reach the 131.00 level, technical analysts said on Friday.

"Mark/lira has moved lower by one and a half big figures, which is good for BTPs," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "The steady grind upwards (in BTPs) looks quite promising."
June BTP futures were up 0.33 at 130.54 by 0818 GMT, after earlier hitting a high of 130.74. Analysts said the market had successfully overcome the 130.54 highs from May 14 and 15.
Analysts at an Italian bank in London said in a client note that Thursday's close above 130.00 had helped alleviate the weakness from a double top formation on hourly charts.
They said the break above 130.54 was a positive move for the contract.
Celaya said the outlook for the contract was bullish, and it was heading towards 132.38, the high on continuation charts set on January 23.
On the downside, the 130.00 psychological level was expected to remain intact, and below there the May 9 high of 129.88 would back it up.
However, analysts said a failure to hold 130.00 could see the market correct back to 129.50, and then 129.00.
At the short end, June Eurolira futures were up three basis points at 93.33 by 0845 GMT. Resistance was pegged at 93.35, with support at 93.30.
